HELP_ID: The ID of this user in your own system. It must match the ID your SSO integration sends, and it can't be changed later.
HELP_DISPLAY_NAME: Shown instead of the username when set.
HELP_DISPLAY_LABEL: A short label shown next to the user's name, like "Staff".
HELP_GROUP_IDS: Comma separated. Users in the same group can mention each other.
PREF_OPTED_IN_NOTIFICATIONS_DESC: Email this user when someone replies to them.
PREF_OPTED_IN_SUBSCRIPTION_NOTIFICATIONS: Email this user about new comments on pages they subscribe to.
PREF_PROFILE_ACTIVITY_PRIVATE_DESC: Hide this user's activity from their public profile.
PREF_PROFILE_COMMENTS_PRIVATE_DESC: Hide comments left on this user's profile from other people.
PREF_PROFILE_DM_DISABLED_DESC: Other users can't send this user direct messages.
HELP_COMMENTS_UPDATED: Changes to the name, avatar, website, and permissions are also applied to this user's existing comments.
ERROR_USERNAME_TAKEN: Another SSO user already has that username.
ERROR_EMAIL_TAKEN: Another SSO user already has that email.
ERROR_ID_TAKEN: An SSO user with that ID already exists.
ERROR_ID_INVALID: An ID is required and must be under 1,000 characters.
ERROR_USERNAME_INVALID: A username is required and must be under 1,000 characters.
ERROR_DISPLAY_NAME_TOO_LONG: The display name must be under 500 characters.
ERROR_DISPLAY_LABEL_TOO_LONG: The display label must be under 100 characters.
ERROR_WEBSITE_URL_INVALID: The website URL must start with http:// or https:// and be under 2,000 characters.
ERROR_GROUP_IDS_INVALID: Use at most 100 group IDs, each under 50 characters.
ERROR_SSO_USER_LIMIT_REACHED: Your plan's SSO user limit has been reached. Upgrade your plan to add more SSO users.
ERROR_NO_PACKAGE: SSO users can't be added until your account has an active plan.
ERROR_USER_NOT_FOUND: That SSO user no longer exists.
ERROR_INTERNAL: Something went wrong saving this SSO user. Please try again.
